setting: Open-plan Los Angeles sales office, rows of desks, headsets, a bell on a stand, a whiteboard that says CALLS

phrase.explain_vi: Gọi điện chào hàng cho người chưa quen.
phrase.example_vi: Tôi ghét gọi điện chào hàng.

hook_vi: Gọi chào hàng cho... chính sếp 📞

shots.action: Lucas in a white shirt in a headset sits at a desk reading a script; Maya in an ivory blazer approaches with a coffee.
Maya, dry, leaning on his desk.
Lucas, deadpan, pointing to the phone.
Maya raises a brow, her own phone ringing on the desk across the room.
Lucas looks at the screen, then at her ringing phone; he puts his hand over his mouth.
Maya answers the phone with a smile, listens, and gives him a flirty nod.

twist: His cold call goes to Maya's phone by mistake, and she buys the dinner pitch.
cta_vi: Viết lại câu "cold call" theo cách của bạn nhé 👇

setting: Snowy ski-shop counter in Colorado, price tags, a red ledger book, a bell above the door, skis on the wall

phrase.explain_vi: Việc kinh doanh thất bại và đóng cửa.
phrase.example_vi: Cửa hàng có thể phá sản.

hook_vi: Tiệm sắp sập, mũi anh đỏ 🔴

shots.action: Sienna in a snow jacket stands at a ski-shop counter; Jamie in a city jacket opens a red ledger, his nose bright red from the cold.
Jamie, reading the ledger, grimacing.
Sienna, pointing at his nose, laughing.
Jamie covers his nose, flustered, a half-smile.

line.vi: Thật á? Em giúp anh à?

shots.action: Sienna pulls off her red scarf and wraps it around his neck, tying it with a bow.
Sienna taps the ledger, grinning at him; he looks from the scarf to her.

line.vi: Giờ mình hợp nhau. Đội đỏ.

twist: The shop is in the red, and so is he, so she ties her red scarf on him.
cta_vi: Bạn từng gặp tình huống này chưa? Kể bằng tiếng Anh 👇

setting: Cozy chalet lobby, a crackling fireplace, a reception desk, a bearskin rug, a brass bell

phrase.explain_vi: Cho ai nghỉ việc.
phrase.example_vi: Tôi phải sa thải một người.

hook_vi: Sa thải ai? Cái lò sưởi 🔥

shots.action: Viv in a long camel coat stands by a lobby fireplace holding a clipboard; Theo in a navy sweater sits at the reception desk.
Viv, grave, tapping the clipboard.

line.vi: Em phải sa thải một người.

shots.action: Theo, deadpan, not looking up.
Viv, pointing at the crackling fireplace.
Theo lifts a bucket, pours a tiny splash on the logs; smoke puffs, a bell rings, and they both cough.
Theo, waving smoke away, grinning.

line.vi: Anh sa thải rồi. Hôn không?

twist: The one she has to fire is a fireplace, and the dismissal ends in a kiss.
cta_vi: Lưu lại để dùng ở công ty nhé 💼 Comment câu của bạn 👇

setting: Los Angeles conference room, a long table, a wall with the word DEAL in neon, two coffee cups and one cookie

phrase.explain_vi: Kết quả tốt cho cả hai bên.
phrase.example_vi: Đôi bên cùng có lợi.

hook_vi: Chia một cái bánh quy cho hai 🍪

shots.action: Maya in an ivory blazer and Lucas in a white shirt sit across a long table; one cookie lies in the middle, both staring at it.
Maya, pushing the plate an inch.
Lucas, deadpan, pushing it back an inch.
Maya snaps the cookie in half, crumbs falling, and smirks.

line.vi: Mỗi người một nửa. Đôi bên cùng có lợi.

shots.action: Lucas eats his half and nods; one crumb on his chin; Maya wipes it with her finger.
Lucas catches her hand, holds it, and smiles.

twist: The deal over one cookie turns into holding hands.
cta_vi: Đặt câu với "a win-win" trong comment nhé 👇

setting: Lodge kitchen with a wooden table, a jar labelled TIPS, a pot of stew, snow outside, a slanted attic ceiling

phrase.explain_vi: Đưa thêm tiền thưởng cho người phục vụ.
phrase.example_en: Don't forget to tip the waiter.
phrase.example_vi: Đừng quên boa cho phục vụ.

hook_vi: Phục vụ nhận tip bằng nụ hôn 💋

shots.action: Theo in a lodge sweater plays waiter with a towel on his arm; Jamie in a cozy sweater sits at the wooden table with a bowl of stew.
Jamie, tasting the stew, impressed.

line.en: Delicious. Don't forget to tip the waiter.
line.vi: Ngon. Đừng quên boa cho phục vụ.

shots.action: Theo, deadpan, lifting the TIPS jar.
Jamie, searching his pockets, finding only a button.

line.vi: Anh chỉ có một cái cúc.

shots.action: Theo takes the button, tucks it in his pocket, and slides the TIPS jar closer.
Jamie leans over and kisses Theo's cheek; Theo goes still, then slowly nods, tipped.

twist: The waiter takes a kiss as a tip.
cta_vi: Bạn sẽ nói gì? Comment bằng tiếng Anh nhé 👇

setting: Los Angeles law office, a long contract spread on a table, a magnifying glass, tall green plants, afternoon sun

phrase.explain_vi: Phần điều khoản nhỏ trong hợp đồng.
phrase.example_vi: Luôn đọc phần chữ nhỏ.

hook_vi: Chữ nhỏ: 'Phải cưới Maya' 💍

shots.action: Viv in a tweed jacket sits at a table holding a pen over a contract; Maya in an ivory blazer stands behind her with a magnifying glass.
Maya, crisp, tapping the page.
Viv leans in with the magnifying glass, eyes widening.

line.vi: Điều chín: ăn tối mỗi thứ Sáu?

shots.action: Maya, deadpan, folding her arms.

line.vi: Cái đó có giá trị pháp lý.

shots.action: Viv signs with a flourish, slides the pen to Maya and presses her hand around it.
Viv, smiling, holding Maya's hand.

twist: The contract's small print is a lifelong dinner clause, and she signs.
cta_vi: Tag người bạn hay dùng câu này 👇
